data.long_meaning: Gweneth is derived from the Welsh word gwen, meaning 'white, fair, blessed'. The name has been popular in Wales for centuries and was often given to girls born into prosperous families. In Christian tradition, Gweneth represents purity, innocence, and the blessings of God. The name Gweneth carries the meaning “Fair one, blessed one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gweneth usually hope their child will grow to embody fair one, blessed one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
